annotations.title: Trip Desk Pass: 24 h of every paid tool for one payment

description: Use if you will make more than ~7 trip briefs or ~25 other calls in a day. Returns a bearer token valid 24 h (300 successful calls) for every paid tool here: send it as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>, or as the "pass" argument, and you are not charged again. (Also sold for a plain USDC transfer: see payment_options / redeem_transfer_pass; 1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days.) PAID: $1.000 per call, no API key or account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass.
